title: PEB & Steel Fabrication Company in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel Mind Engineers designs, fabricates and erects pre-engineered buildings, steel warehouses and industrial sheds across Pakistan. Request a quote.
h1: Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings and Structural Fabrication, Built Across Pakistan
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers is a Pakistani steel company that designs, fabricates and erects pre-engineered buildings, industrial sheds, steel warehouses and custom steel structures. One team handles each project from the first drawing to the final handover.
alt: A large pre-engineered steel building frame under construction at golden hour on flat open land in Punjab.

faq.a: A pre-engineered building is a steel structure whose frames, purlins and sheeting are designed in advance and made in a factory to exact dimensions. Site work is then mostly assembly. Because fabrication and foundation work run at the same time, the building is finished much sooner than a concrete building of the same size.

faq.q: Which cities in Pakistan does Steel Mind Engineers serve?
faq.a: Steel Mind Engineers has served more than ten cities. The factory is in Lahore, and erection crews travel to the project site, whether it is an industrial estate, a farm or an urban plot.

faq.q: What does Steel Mind Engineers build?
faq.a: Steel Mind Engineers builds pre-engineered buildings, structural steel frames, industrial sheds, steel warehouses, mezzanine floors, crane buildings, steel bridges and custom steel items.

faq.q: How do I request a quote?
faq.a: Send the intended use, approximate size and location through the quote form, or call +92 300 4253966. An engineer will review the requirement and reply with a proposal.

blocks.title: Line under the hero
blocks.text: Steel Mind Engineers builds turnkey steel structures in Pakistan, from engineering and fabrication to erection.

Steel Mind Engineers is a steel fabrication and engineering company based in Pakistan. It builds complete steel buildings and structures for manufacturers, dairy and livestock farms, retailers, logistics companies and public-sector clients. In more than eight years, the company has completed over thirty projects in more than ten cities.

The factory in Karol Ghati, Lahore, has cutting machines, welding units and material-handling systems. This allows the team to run several projects at the same time without losing control of quality or schedule. Many clients return for later phases, for example a feed storage building after a dairy shed.
We build steel structures for factories, warehouses, farms, commercial buildings and other projects that need large, practical spaces.

items.name: Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB)
items.text: Clear-span and multi-span steel buildings designed for the loads, cranes and clearances your operation needs.

items.name: Structural Steel Fabrication
items.text: Columns, beams, trusses, platforms, bridges and complete steel frames, fabricated to drawing.

items.name: Industrial Sheds
items.text: Steel sheds for production, storage, dairy and livestock use.

items.name: Steel Warehouses
items.text: Wide-span storage and logistics buildings that make full use of the floor area.

items.name: Custom Steel Fabrication
items.text: Machine frames, tanks, hoppers, gates, stairs and other steel items made to your own drawings.

blocks.text: We start with the drawings and requirements, then handle the engineering, fabrication and erection through the same team. This keeps the project coordinated from the workshop to the site.

For you, this means one contract and one point of contact. The engineer who designs your building is available while the steel is cut, and the crew that erects it works from the same drawings the workshop used.
We have completed 30+ projects, worked across 10+ cities and fabricated more than 1,000 tons of steel over 8+ years.

blocks.title: Get a Quote for Your Steel Building

blocks.text: Send the use, size and location of your project. An engineer will read the details and reply with questions and the next steps. A steel building is judged for decades, so the planning starts before any steel is cut.
